methodology: Pinned specification sources and public topic streams were fetched in full. Analysis selects mechanisms, consequential replies, and dated scope decisions. Fetch completeness is not a claim of exhaustive semantic review. Deleted/hidden posts, private Discord, video, and all historical PRs are outside completeness claims. Discussion timestamps use UTC.
